cipher.summary: Fixed AbortError incorrectly tripping the circuit breaker, scoped image-generation breaker bookkeeping to the transport layer, and made meechie-studio-text's two call sites share the existing providerAdapter singleton instead of recreating the breaker per request.
cipher.risks: meechie-tool's two call sites still recreate the breaker per request (deferred, documented); the dual-seam-layout gap means this breaker may not protect the live image-generation endpoint (pre-existing, tracked as hardest-fixes item #1); no live-traffic validation of any of this (no XAI_API_KEY in this environment).
